channel.description: Recent content in Projects on Yeabsira // portfolio

item.title: Lease Loop
item.description: A leasing app built for the Northfina × Hive Helsinki hackathon. My focus was the Money Core: saved quotes, agreed contract pricing, and invoices that explain VAT changes.

item.title: Literary Lions Forum
item.description: A book discussion forum built with Go and SQLite. Readers can publish posts, reply to discussions, react to content, and find conversations through full-text search.

item.title: Movies API
item.description: A Go REST API for movies, actors, and genres, with SQLite persistence, filtering, pagination, and API-key authentication. Organized into handler, service, and repository layers.

item.title: ART Interface
item.description: A browser-based tool for encoding and decoding text art. A Go server renders the interface, processes form input, and returns the result with clear validation feedback.
